meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Team-first maximum-saturation research orchestration. ALWAYS asks which final format to render (PDF+DOCX default), then stands up a max-size cooperating team (team_create): one member per axis plus skeptic/red-team members for ultradebate/hyperdebate cross-critique, explore/librarian lanes, live journaling, an EXPAND loop until leads run dry, claims proven by code or the claim-graph gate, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind visual-QA and `writing` proofread gates. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research: the word 'ulw-research' in any prefix form, any 'ulw' research wording including combined invocations like 'mass ulw research', 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 围绕任意选题派出多路研究者交叉辩论，输出带引用与图表的深度报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果一件事需要顶住不同观点，把证据追到源码并整理成正式报告。
copy.tagline_en: Turn any question into a cited, multi-perspective report with charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need well-sourced analysis weighing opposing views, ending in a polished report.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把一次研究请求变成最大规模调研:先问最终格式(默认 PDF+DOCX),按研究轴各派成员并配怀疑/红队交叉批驳,线索跑完为止,争议说法须由代码或证据门证明,交付逐条带出处的综合报告,过视觉 QA 与写作校对门。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做研究、深度研究或超精确调查(不限语言),或说出 "ulw-research"、"ultradebate"/"hyperdebate" 等研究关键词时触发。普通提问、调试或收集背景信息不触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 调研脑机接口的伦理争议,输出 PDF 版报告。
say.note: 这句话会触发技能并定下交付格式。

say.text: 对固态电池量产瓶颈做 hyperdebate 研究,给出带出处的结论。
say.note: 会先让红队交叉批驳,再收敛结题。

say.text: mass ulw research:整理主动推理近五年综述,线索耗竭后合并。
say.note: 按大规模分波扩线方式开跑。

howto.what_en: On activation: asks format (PDF+DOCX default), staffs full team (one per axis + skeptic/red-team), expands leads until dry, proves contested claims via code or claim-graph, delivers a cited synthesis passing visual QA and writing proofread.
howto.when_en: Only on explicit research demand: 'ulw-research', any 'ulw' wording, 'ultradebate'/'hyperdebate', or a research/deep-research request. Never for ordinary Q&A, debugging, or context-gathering.

say_en.text: Run ulw-research on the ethics of brain-computer interfaces, deliver a PDF report.
say_en.note: This phrase triggers the skill and fixes the format.

say_en.text: Do a hyperdebate research on solid-state battery scale-up bottlenecks, with citations.
Mass ulw research: survey active inference reviews from the last five years.
say_en.note: Runs collection as large chained DAG waves.
